integrity: Explicit finite graph data, exact integer counts, mathematical reduction and two standalone exhaustive verification programs are included; this is a same-model scientific review, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: The general one-update law is elementary and not claimed novel.
The exact finite census concerns the three listed eighteen-vertex Levi graphs only.
Known broader fixed-point enumeration may imply parts of the equilibrium counts but not the demonstrated complete basin histograms.
Historical-priority completeness and independent scientific validation have not been established.
title: The three nine-point cubic configurations have distinct NOR basin spectra
